[support-deceased] If an account holder has died (effective 2025-01-01)
What happens to the account

Once we're notified, we freeze the account and cards to protect them. Recurring payments stop. Direct deposits received after the date of death may be returned to the sender.

After Account Services confirms who's authorized, the balance is paid to the estate.

## Timing

Account Services contacts you within 2 business days. Please don't try to sign in to the account or use its cards.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[support-deceased] If an account holder has died (effective 2025-01-01)
We're sorry for your loss. Here's how to let us know that a Tallowbrook member has died.

## Tell us

Email support@tallowbrook.example with the subject Bereavement, or message support. Support passes every bereavement case to our Account Services team, who handle it from start to finish.

## What Account Services will ask for

- The death certificate
- Proof that you're the executor or administrator of the estate, or the next of kin
- Your photo ID

## What happens to the account

Once we're notified, we freeze the

[cushion-negative-after-dispute] Negative balance after a dispute (effective 2025-01-01)
money to bring your balance back to zero. Any incoming deposit repays it automatically.

## Fees

There are no fees for a negative balance ($0.00).

## If it isn't repaid

As with Cushion, if a negative balance lasts 60 days, the account is restricted until it's repaid. On Plus and Premium, Cushion is suspended while the balance is negative for longer than 30 days.

## Can't pay it right away?

Message support. If you're going through financial hardship, we can pass your case to our Account Services team.

Still stuck?

[close-inactivity] Inactive accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
We may close accounts that have a $0.00 balance and no activity for 12 months.

## Notice

We email you at least 30 days before closing. Any activity during that time, such as a deposit or a card purchase, keeps the account open.

## Fees

We don't charge inactivity fees ($0.00) on any plan.

## Accounts with money in them

We don't close accounts for inactivity while they hold a balance, including money in Savings Pockets.

## Paid plans

[close-balance] What happens to your money when you close (effective 2025-01-01)
When you close your account in the app, we send any remaining money to you.

## How we send it

- If you have a linked external account, we send the balance there by ACH.
- If you don't, we mail a check to the address on your profile.

Either way, it's sent within 10 business days of closing.

## Savings Pockets

Money in your pockets, and any interest earned up to the closing date, is included in the payout.

[support-power-of-attorney] Power of attorney (effective 2025-01-01)
How long it takes

Account Services replies within 2 business days to confirm what they received, and may ask for more information.

## Until it's approved

We can't share information or take instructions from you until Account Services has approved the document. That includes freezing cards or changing plans.

## If the account holder is in danger

If you think the account holder is being exploited financially, tell us. We treat that as urgent.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[direct-deposit-setup] Setting up direct deposit (effective 2025-01-01)

## Why it helps

- You may get paid up to 2 days early.
- Plus and Premium members need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days to use Cushion.

## Splitting a paycheck

Your employer may let you split your pay between accounts. You can also set up an automatic transfer from your main balance to a Savings Pocket on payday.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

- **Denied:** we've sent an explanation, and any provisional credit will be taken back.

Most disputes finish within 45 days, and some take up to 90 days. We'll message you whenever the status changes.

You can upload documents or add notes to an open dispute from the case page at any time.

How long does it take for a deceased member's balance to be paid to the estate?

You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.

response.text: {"answer":"After Account Services confirms who is authorized, the balance is paid to the estate. The help center doesn’t specify how long that payment takes; Account Services contacts you within 2 business days.","citations":["support-deceased"],"abstain":false}
